findings.title: Thirty-three published dashboards overlap the same brief
findings.detail: Each of these directories publishes a full dashboard for the same 15-sport brief, with different counts and different levels of evidence. There is no marker of which one is authoritative, so a reader landing on any of them can be misled.
findings.evidence: 53 directories with an index.html: atlas, audit65, beacon, board, brief, cadence, canon, clarity, command, covered, current, daily, daily-audit, daily-picks, desk, evidence, executive, final, final-desk, focus, forward, fresh, horizon, hub, latest, ledger, live, live-desk, liveboard, master, meridian, monitor, now, olbg, playbook, portal, pulse, quest, recheck, reconcile, relay, signal, site, slate, sports, summit, survey, today, update, vanguard, vantage, verified, zenith

findings.title: The root dashboard advertises a stale snapshot and points at the weakest desk
findings.detail: The root page's status stripe still reads 2026-10-22 08:15 UTC and its primary call to action opens `/monitor/`, which states that no high-confidence picks cleared. The most complete desk from the same day, `/signal/`, is not linked from the root navigation at all.
findings.evidence: index.html stripe: not found; root navigation references to /signal/: 0; /monitor/ page text: 'No high-confidence picks cleared.'

findings.title: The cross-layer link checker trips over any non-UTF-8 file
findings.detail: `scripts/integration_audit.py` reads every `*.html` under the repository as UTF-8 with no fallback. A single Latin-1 response stored under `data/` was enough to raise UnicodeDecodeError and fail the whole suite. Captures in this layer are therefore stored as `.txt`, and the checker itself is left untouched as another session's file.
findings.evidence: Reproduced locally: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_integration` failed with UnicodeDecodeError at `scripts/integration_audit.py:127` while `data/ledger/raw/handball_spain.html` existed.

findings.title: Duplicate element ids in a published page
findings.detail: Anchor targets repeat inside the page, so a fragment link can land on the wrong row.

findings.title: CI rebuilds many layers and checks them for drift
findings.detail: The Pages workflow rebuilds 63 test modules' worth of layers and fails if generated HTML differs from what is committed. Any new layer has to be added to both the rebuild steps and the drift list or it will silently rot. This layer adds its own step and drift paths.
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/pages.yml — 'Fail if any generated page or data file is stale'

findings.title: Earlier desks publish numbers that cannot be reconciled with each other
findings.detail: For the same day the repository contains, among others, 101 fixtures (/signal/), 133 (/liveboard/), 24 (/monitor/), 40 (/focus/) and 188 stored rows on the root. They describe different capture windows rather than contradicting one another, but the pages do not say so consistently.
findings.evidence: Each desk's own build output; see /ledger/verification.html for the full comparison.
